subject: The plug-in editor window frame: what identifies it and what its chrome exposes
question: How is an open plug-in editor identified, and what does its frame expose?

reverify.command: On an occupied insert slot (an AXGroup described with the plug-in name) press the child AXButton described 열기 / open, then walk the resulting AXDialog to depth 4 recording role, AXDescription, AXTitle and AXValue.
reverify.expected: the window is named after the track or patch, not the plug-in; the preset selector is an AXPopUpButton whose value is the preset name
reverify.cost: ~3 min; close the window afterwards or later harness runs fail their zero-editors precondition

method: Opened the editor through the element the strip actually offers rather than by a menu, then read the frame before reading anything inside it -- the frame is what a caller has to bind to, and binding to the wrong thing is how the earlier duplicate-editor defects happened.

observations.what: how the slot offers to open

observations.name: Absolute Zero
observations.note: that is the track and patch name; the plug-in is Compressor and appears nowhere in the title

conclusion: A plug-in editor window is named after the track or patch, never after the plug-in. The Compressor's editor opened as an AXDialog titled Absolute Zero, which is the instrument on that track -- so a caller matching a window by plug-in name finds nothing, and one matching by track name finds the right window for the wrong reason if two plug-ins on the same track are open. The frame itself reads cleanly: close, toolbar, link, a zoom AXMenuButton whose title is 100%, bypass, a compare AXCheckBox, three pairs of grouped buttons (previous/next, copy/paste, undo/redo) and a preset AXPopUpButton carrying 기본 프리셋 as its value. The route in is the occupied slot's own child AXButton 열기; the AXGroup that represents the slot advertises no actions at all.
limits: One plug-in on one track. Whether every plug-in editor is titled by the track, and what happens when two are open on the same track, was not measured.
ko-KR only. Every description here is localised and none of the English renderings were read.
